other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Data Leakage (Scaling)
other_failure_modes.description: Global transformations (like standard scaling) are applied to the entire training set prior to cross-validation splitting. This leaks statistics from the validation folds into the training folds, making CV scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides a robust solution with solid data cleaning, feature engineering, and a sophisticated optimized ensemble. However, there are two distinct issues: a logical bug that completely skips the execution of target encoding, and cross-validation leakage caused by scaling the entire training set before the CV loop.
